description: Repo-scale (aspnet-helpdesk): agent deactivation must cascade across list, ticket-creation, and ticket-reassignment call sites
prompts: Add `POST /api/agents/{id}/deactivate`, which sets `active` to false. Deactivation must cascade across THREE places: (1) `GET /api/agents` excludes inactive agents by default, but includes them when called with `?includeInactive=true`; (2) `POST /api/tickets` must reject (400) assigning a ticket to a deactivated agent at creation time; (3) `PATCH /api/tickets/{id}` must ALSO reject (400) reassigning a ticket to a deactivated agent - both mutation paths that can newly assign an agent to a ticket must enforce this, not just creation.
name: add_csharp_helpdesk_agent_deactivation
